###How long is the Buccaneer Bay Cruise?###
It is 2.5 hours in duration from 6 pm-8:30 pm. 

###Where is it located?###
 [2700 Shelter Island Dr. San Diego, CA 92106 ](https://www.google.com/maps/dir//triton+charters/data=!4m6!4m5!1m1!4e2!1m2!1m1!1s0x80deab7fd72e5973:0x221232ad56159d50?sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiixM_Dt7vzAhVar5UCHdkPAwkQ9Rd6BAhtEAU)

###Food and beverages?###
Please feel free to bring your own snacks! 
Halloween inspired cocktails, beer, wine, and spirits are available for purchase at our bar.
